summary: ELBIM AS (org. no. 998 577 020) is a private limited company (AS) based in Bergen, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2012-07-03. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 62.200 (Konsulentvirksomhet tilknyttet informasjonsteknologi og forvaltning og drift av it-systemer). In its 2025 accounts (company level) operating revenue was NOK 527 235 and net income was -NOK 1 752. Board chair: Eirik Andre Linde.
